name: PCPEP
summary: PCPEP (1-phenyl-1-piperidinylcyclopentane) is a designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, which has dissociative effects. It is the ring-contracted cyclopentyl homologue of PCP and has around 1/10th the potency of PCP, making it a similar potency to ketamine. It has been sold as an illicit drug in Japan.

pharmacology.text: PCPEP (1-phenyl-1-piperidinylcyclopentane) is a designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, which has dissociative effects.

uses.text: PCPEP (1-phenyl-1-piperidinylcyclopentane) is a designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, which has dissociative effects. It has been sold as an illicit drug in Japan.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Dissociatives of its class can cause confusion, loss of coordination, nausea, raised blood pressure and a frightening sense of detachment.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的解離劑類藥物可能造成意識混亂、協調能力喪失、噁心、血壓上升，以及令人恐懼的脫離感。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的解离剂类药物可能造成意识混乱、协调能力丧失、恶心、血压上升，以及令人恐惧的脱离感。

fact.en: Its ring has five carbons instead of PCP's six, a change chemists call ring contraction, which usually weakens a drug of this family.
fact.zh: 它的環有五個碳，而非 PCP 的六個，化學家稱這種改動為「環收縮」，通常會減弱這個家族藥物的作用。
fact.zhHans: 它的环有五个碳，而非 PCP 的六个，化学家称这种改动为「环收缩」，通常会减弱这个家族药物的作用。
